name: Hit 'N Run VC
summary: A Vice City street racing group with nine races spread over four neighbourhoods.
body: PowerPyx lists three races at Salton and two each at La Perle, Ocean Beach and Gloriana Key.
PowerPyx says an invitation arrives through a group chat, and that each race at a location must be run before the next one opens.

facts.location: Vice City: Salton, La Perle, Ocean Beach, Gloriana Key

name: Animal Crackers
summary: A race group of eight events held at four spots in Lummox County and Mariana County.
body: PowerPyx lists two races each at Grayson, Redshaw's, Ranchers and Big Pine, and gives no unlock condition.

name: Gellhorn International Raceway
summary: A circuit south of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County that hosts eleven races and its own timed trials.
body: PowerPyx says an introduction event opens a five-race amateur series called Keep It PG, which in turn opens the remaining races.
PowerPyx also lists a Gellhorn Raceway Trial and a Gellhorn Dragway Trial among the 13 race challenges.

facts.location: Kelly County, south of Port Gellhorn

name: Boone Speedway
summary: A speedway in the south-west corner of Hamlet that runs two elimination races.
body: PowerPyx lists two elimination races here and a separate Boone Speedway Trial among the race challenges.
RacingNews.co says Boone Speedway, in Hamlet, Vice-Dale County, is the game's version of Ocala Speedway, a 3/8-mile egg-shaped dirt oval north of Tampa.
It quotes the real track's owner, radio host Bubba Clem, saying on air that the layout is exact but that the game's track looks nicer and has an inside wall at turn one that the real one lacks.

name: Ambrosia Raceway
summary: A track in north Ambrosia, Kelly County, that runs two demolition races.
body: PowerPyx lists two demolition races here and a separate Ambrosia Raceway Trial among the race challenges.

name: Thrillbilly Mud Club
summary: An off-road venue in north Kelly County with eight races and six of the game's thirteen race challenges.
body: PowerPyx lists six dirt track races and two oval races, introduced through an optional job during the second chapter.
Its race challenges, per PowerPyx, are an air time stunt run plus drag, hill climb, dirt track, oval and swamp run trials.

name: Unique races
summary: The game counts 40 unique races in six groups, each paid for with an entry fee and a vehicle rental.
body: PowerPyx gives the groups as Hit 'N Run VC (9), Animal Crackers (8), Gellhorn International Raceway (11), Boone Speedway (2), Ambrosia Raceway (2) and Thrillbilly Mud Club (8).
PowerPyx says race starts show as blue map icons from about 100 metres away, that winning 30 counts for the completion checklist and that winning 20 earns a trophy.
The guide gives no fee or prize amounts.

IGN's racing page lists 39 races where PowerPyx counts 40; the gap is Gellhorn Raceway, which IGN gives 10 races and PowerPyx 11. IGN agrees that 30 race wins with gold in first place are needed for the 100 percent requirement.

IGN says more races in a group open after a bronze in the earlier ones, that NPCs around each venue hand out races, and that a rental car can be paid for or an owned car entered if it is the exact class required.
IGN's per-race maximum payouts run from 1,500 dollars (Boone Speedway Oval, Trash Dash, Shoreline) to 6,000 dollars (Gellhorn Full Loop and Full Loop CCW, Big Mud, Beach Blast).

facts.location: Vice City, Mariana, Kelly, Lummox and Vice-Dale counties

name: Race challenges
summary: Thirteen timed or scored solo events with bronze, silver and gold medals, separate from the 40 races.
body: PowerPyx names them: Ambrosia Raceway Trial, Hamlet BMX Stunt Run, Boone Speedway Trial, Gellhorn Raceway Trial, Gellhorn Dragway Trial, Kalaga Cycling Trial, six Mud Club events and the Waning Sands Motocross Stunt Run.
According to PowerPyx, ten gold medals are needed for the completion checklist; the guide does not list the medal thresholds.

facts.location: Ambrosia, Hamlet, Boone Speedway, Gellhorn, Kalaga, Mud Club, Waning Sands

name: Griffin Shooting Range
summary: A range in north-west Vice City with six courses, each offering three gold medals.
body: PowerPyx names the courses as 3-Point, Hook, Loop, Maze, Compound and Villa, which adds up to 18 gold medals.
PowerPyx says a 5 dollar waiver pass from the clerk opens the challenges, a missing weapon type can be rented for 10 dollars, and Lucia is the better pick here because she moves faster.

facts.players: Either lead; Lucia recommended by PowerPyx

name: Rodgers Ranch Shooting Range
summary: A range on the north-east edge of Port Gellhorn with six themed courses, each offering four gold medals.
body: PowerPyx names the courses as Market, Zombie, Hunting, Saloon, Cops & Robbers and Alien, which adds up to 24 gold medals.

PowerPyx says the courses call for pistols, SMGs, shotguns, assault rifles, revolvers, tactical rifles and sniper rifles, and that finishing or quitting any challenge permanently raises the Focus stat.

name: Top Fun drone races
summary: Drone time trials flown at 14 sites, three per site, for 42 in total.
body: PowerPyx lists the sites as Hamlet, Watson Bay, Capri, Buckskin Swamp, Balsero, Downtown, Dalton Island, Vice Beach, Waning Sands, Ambrosia, Port Gellhorn, Draper Island, Moreau Sawmill and Millport.
PowerPyx says beating the par time on the first two trials at a site opens the third, which only has to be finished, and that Dalton Island can only be reached by boat or aircraft.
According to PowerPyx all 42 are needed for the completion checklist, and winning one at every site earns a trophy.

IGN says each Top Fun drone race starts from a van with a flat entry fee, after which retries are free; the drone must pass every pink ring and finish under par, and beating par opens the next race in the area.
IGN gives the same prize at every site: 750 dollars for the first race, 1,500 for the second and 3,000 for the third, so the 42 races pay 73,500 dollars in all.

IGN says all 42 are needed for 100 percent and that trying one counts toward the Master of None trophy. PowerPyx, cited in this entry, says the third race at a site only has to be finished; IGN gives par times for all three.

name: Playable video games
summary: Four games can be played inside the game: three on a home console and one on arcade cabinets.
body: PowerPyx names Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind as titles for the JoySystem console at the TV in the player's home.
PowerPyx says Bang For Your Buck is only found on arcade machines out in the world, for example outside the Bargain World clothing store in Port Gellhorn.
According to PowerPyx the home console cannot be used during the second chapter, and starting each game once is enough for the completion checklist.

IGN names four video and arcade games, Bang For Your Buck, Street Trash 3: Dezombifier, Tenebrae Lux and Time Jackers: Rewind, all playable on the home console after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; Bang For Your Buck and Street Trash 3 are also in arcades around Leonida.
IGN says all four must be completed for 100 percent.

name: Pool
summary: Pool is played against seven named-venue opponents in bars and cafes; the world has 17 tables in all.
body: PowerPyx has located six opponents: Skeeter's in Hamlet, Zotico's in Balsero, The Thirsty Wolf in Belville, Jacob's Tavern in Millport, Delights Cabaret in Port Gellhorn and Kowaachobee Cafe & Bar in Buckskin Swamp; the seventh was not yet found.
According to PowerPyx, beating five different opponents counts for the completion checklist, and pool is one of the activities that raises Focus.

facts.location: Bars, taverns and cafes across Leonida

name: Mini golf
summary: Three mini golf courses are open for play: King Gator, Frontier and Dino Golf.
body: PowerPyx places King Gator Adventure Golf in Buckskin Swamp, Frontier Adventure Golf in Waning Sands and Dino Golf Challenge in Frogswater.
According to PowerPyx, finishing two of the three counts for the completion checklist, and the Sports challenges include 18-hole rounds at King Gator and Frontier.

IGN says mini golf is one of the sports activities needed for 100 percent, that King Gator and Frontier charge a fee and can be played solo or with the partner, and that the abandoned Dino Golf in Frogswater, Kelly County, is free.
IGN says Dino Golf's 18 dinosaur-themed holes, from Big Boned to Great Glacier, each award gold for 2 strokes, silver for 3 and bronze for 4; its table skips a Hole 4.
IGN lists the mini golf challenges as Golf Rookie, Golf Pro and Double Hole in One.

name: Golf courses
summary: Two full-size golf challenges exist besides the mini golf: Leaf Links and Mount Hailes.
body: PowerPyx places the Leaf Links Golf Challenge in Vice Beach and the Mount Hailes Golf Challenge at the Mount Hailes Club in Waning Sands.
PowerPyx says the large courses do not count toward the mini golf requirement on the completion checklist.

facts.location: Leaf Links, Vice Beach; Mount Hailes Club, Waning Sands

name: Basketball hoops
summary: There are 100 basketball hoops around Leonida, and the game tracks a scored shot at each.
body: According to PowerPyx, scoring at 90 of the 100 hoops counts for the completion checklist.
PowerPyx lists Sports challenges for scoring at three hoops in a day, ten shots in a row, a hoop in every county and all 100 hoops.

IGN numbers the 100 hoops 0 to 99 and counts 49 in Vice-Dale County, 18 in Mariana, 14 each in Kelly and Leonard and 5 in Lummox, though it lists only four Lummox hoop numbers. Its 100% guide also mentions 99 hoops in one place.
IGN says each score gives +2 percent Focus, with Focus gains capped at five per 30 minutes of real time.
IGN lists the rewards as a Narcos Cap from the Eris Shop for 10 hoops, three tattoos for 50 and an Alternative Kit from the Eris Shop for all 100.
IGN lists the basketball challenges as Basketball Rookie, Basketball Streak and Basketball Pro.

name: Meditation
summary: Ten meditation spots hold 18 meditations, because most spots can be completed once by each lead.
body: PowerPyx names the spots as Jason's House, Smooth Sand, Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall, Seaside and Ascent Mountain.
PowerPyx says the spot at Jason's house is only available in the first chapter, and that Ascent Mountain at the peak of Mount Kalaga appears only after the others are done.
According to PowerPyx, 15 of the 18 count for the completion checklist and spots show as purple map icons when close.

facts.location: Mariana, Kelly, Lummox and Leonard counties

name: Gym workouts
summary: Weights raise Strength and treadmills or bikes raise Cardio, at home early on and at paid fitness studios later.
body: PowerPyx says weights sit on the terrace of the first home, and that fitness studios charge a membership fee.
PowerPyx reports that an unfinished workout gives no gain, that protein afterwards speeds recovery, and that the two leads can train together at a studio.
PowerPyx lists Fitness challenges for joining a gym and for using every type of equipment in one day, and a trophy for maxing Strength on both leads at once.

name: Bret's Target Decks
summary: Fifteen hunting assignments from Bret Vogel, playable only as Jason, each asking for a specific animal.
body: PowerPyx says they open during the second chapter with a first hunt in Lummox County near Mount Kalaga, where the target is a deer.
PowerPyx reports that Bret lends a hunting rifle called the Killtelligence SM-69, that clean head or heart shots pay more, and that the first hunt pays 500 dollars.
According to PowerPyx all 15 count for the completion checklist.

facts.location: Starts at Bret's cabin, Lummox County

name: Fishing challenges
summary: Fishing covers 35 species, with contests against Cal and several Survival challenges built around it.
body: PowerPyx counts 35 fish and lists a trophy for beating Cal in a fishing challenge, which opens early in the first chapter.
PowerPyx lists Survival challenges for landing a fish of 20 pounds or more, catching three fish with each lure type in a day, four species in six minutes and every species.
PowerPyx also names fishing as one way to raise Focus.

name: Stunts
summary: The game tracks 397 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps.
body: PowerPyx gives 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, with any 300 counting for the completion checklist.

name: Challenges
summary: Eighty optional challenges sit in eight categories of ten and are available from the start.
body: PowerPyx gives the categories as Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle.
According to PowerPyx, 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

name: Activity types
summary: A trophy asks the player to try each of nine activity types once.
body: PowerPyx's trophy guide names hunting, fishing, golf, pool, basketball, shooting ranges and racing (a car race, race challenge or drone race) among the nine; it does not spell out the full nine in the text read.
